finalText:
`package.json` pins `fast-parse` at `1.4.2` — the exact version `NOTES.md` says was yanked after a prototype-pollution report. `1.4.3` is the fix. The other three deps check out fine: `date-fmt` unmaintained but harmless, `pg-lite` and `redis-min` both current.

`AUDIT.md` is written with all four findings, worst first:

1. `src/routes/internal.js` — no auth on the internal endpoints, now internet-facing since the VPN was retired.
2. `src/repo/report.js` — SQL injection via string-built queries in `runSavedReport`.
3. `config/staging.js` — staging DB password committed in plain text.
4. `package.json` — `fast-parse` stuck on the yanked `1.4.2`.

Nothing else in the tree was touched — this stayed a read-only audit.
